spec: How each interior kind can be entered. A body gets in through the first entrance whose tags it is allowed (embodiment.allowedApproachTags) and none of which it is blocked from (embodiment.blockedTileTags). A body with no allowedApproachTags may use any entrance it is not blocked from. lineKey: a surface-fallbacks.json key said as you come in that way ({body} is the body's name). refuseKey: said when no entrance lets this body in and the body has no blockedLine of its own for it.
